findings.claim: MEMORY rejects references to a shown 'published report' before checking source availability. The repeated out-of-scope decline preserves a guidance error: valid contextual reasoning becomes NI solely because of its wording.
findings.guidance_basis: NI is appropriate only when a probable answer is unreasonable given available context; citing a shown report is not reliance on memory. [Handbook 8.2.3](https://www.cochrane.org/authors/handbooks-and-manuals/handbook/current/chapter-08).
findings.failing_test: Shown fulltext quotes 'central web-based randomisation'; 1.2=PY, rationale='The published report describes central web-based randomisation, supporting concealment.' -> retain PY; currently NI.

findings.claim: ANOTHER_RECORD rejects every matching phrase, even when the quoted source explicitly reports that record's relevant content. This bypasses A3's allowance for context reported by a shown source and introduces a new false rejection.
findings.guidance_basis: A3 distinguishes reliance on unseen documents from reliance on what a shown source reports. Available contextual evidence can justify PY/PN under [Handbook 8.2.3](https://www.cochrane.org/authors/handbooks-and-manuals/handbook/current/chapter-08).
findings.failing_test: Shown abstract and quote='Another registry record reports central web-based randomisation.' Rationale='The abstract reports another registry record describing central web-based randomisation, supporting concealment.'; 1.2=PY -> retain PY; currently NI.

findings.claim: The final assertion expects PY although the only source says randomisation details were omitted. Matching the shown identifier establishes identity, not concealment context. This positive fixture endorses an unsupported inference; use substantive context to test identifier acceptance.
findings.guidance_basis: A probable answer requires a reasonable contextual basis; an omission and a matching identifier supply none here. [Handbook 8.2.3](https://www.cochrane.org/authors/handbooks-and-manuals/handbook/current/chapter-08).
findings.failing_test: Existing final case: quote='Randomisation details were omitted.'; rationale='ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT00000001 shows randomisation details, so concealed.' -> NI, not the asserted PY.
